# Third-party dependencies

The Voice APK incorporates OkHttp 4.12.0, Okio JVM 3.6.0 and Kotlin stdlib 1.9.10, licensed under Apache License 2.0. The build downloads the original JARs from Maven Central and verifies SHA-256. It includes the license and the OkHttp public suffix notice in the APK.

- [OkHttp source and license](https://github.com/square/okhttp/tree/parent-4.12.0)
- [Okio source and license](https://github.com/square/okio/tree/parent-3.6.0)
- [Kotlin source and license](https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/tree/v1.9.10)
